radcliffe.title: The Radcliffe Camera
radcliffe.context: Designed by James Gibbs and built with a bequest from the physician Dr John Radcliffe, it was England's first circular library and remains one of Oxford's most recognisable buildings.

sheldonian.title: The Sheldonian Theatre
sheldonian.context: Sir Christopher Wren's first major commission, funded by Archbishop Gilbert Sheldon. It is the University's ceremonial hall — degrees are still conferred here today.

bodleian.title: The Bodleian Library
bodleian.context: Founded by Sir Thomas Bodley, the 'Boduleian' is one of the oldest libraries in Europe and a legal deposit library — entitled to a copy of every book published in Britain.

magdalen.title: Magdalen College Tower
magdalen.context: The Great Tower stands over the River Cherwell. Every May Morning, the college choir sings from its top at 6am to crowds gathered on Magdalen Bridge below.

clarendon.title: The Clarendon Building
clarendon.context: Designed by Nicholas Hawksmoor and built to house the Oxford University Press, funded partly by profits from the Earl of Clarendon's 'History of the Rebellion'.
